correctness.rationale: For arbitrary x the P disjoint-block pairs of histories commute, yielding the upper bound. For a source with n distinct symbols, original positions are the first occurrences in any descendant. Each of two occupied original gaps determines the execution order unless their sources are disjoint, while a single occupied gap determines the second insertion position from the first internal adjacent equality. These arguments classify all histories; the code independently checks 105 distinct-source parameter pairs and the small-alphabet upper bound.

value.rationale: Exact worst-case two-error sphere volume and the entire history-fiber structure are natural invariants for counting and packing in duplication channels. A September 2026 theorem proves this sharp volume for every even block length; the new theorem resolves the odd-length gap uniformly in the high-alphabet q>=n regime, all n and odd k>=3.
